newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rembrandt sues Philip Morris in UK.
newsitem.headline: Rembrandt sues Philip Morris in UK.

text.p: South Africa's Rembrandt Group Ltd confirmed on Tuesday that its tobacco division had issued a writ against U.S. cigarette group Philip Morris Cos Inc in Britain but it declined to give further details.
"It's about contracts but we cannot disclose any information about the case," a company spokesman said. The writ was lodged in the High Court in London at the end of last week, he added.

The London Times reported on Tuesday that the writ alleged Philip Morris had broken an agreement precluding it from using tobacco trademarks -- including the famous Marlboro Man -- in the southern African region.
Rembrandt was seeking an injunction against further breaches and was pressing for unspecified damages, the paper reported.
